title: 🛰️ After 27 Years in Space… the Terra Satellite Gets Ready to Retire!
body: 🛰️ After 27 Years in Space… the Terra Satellite Gets Ready to Retire!

The space agency announced that the Terra satellite will stop collecting scientific data on December 1. The satellite was launched in 1999 on a mission that was supposed to last only six years, but it kept working for 27 years, watching the Earth and documenting climate change, forests, and oceans. The team will lower its orbit using the remaining fuel, then switch off its systems next January, while its data remains free and available to everyone.
Simply put: a satellite that worked four times longer than expected — now it is time to say goodbye.
